matchmaking_summary: The candidate presents a strong background in educational leadership and classroom management, with extensive experience in curriculum development and student engagement. Their skills in Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, are highlighted, indicating proficiency in administration and presentation. The possession of the Maryland Child Care Credential and CDA-Infants & Toddlers Teaching certification suggests a commitment to professional growth and expertise in early childhood education. The leadership roles and ability to solve behavioral issues efficiently demonstrate strong problem-solving skills and adaptability, which are valuable for any Education Coordinator position.
